# Test fixture corpus

Layout is stable from WP0 on; content is generated by later work packages.

- `engine/opcodes/` — 2-way diff cases for the engine golden tests (WP2 T2.2).
  One JSON file per case: `{"a": [...lines], "b": [...lines], "expected_opcodes":
  [[tag, i1, i2, j1, j2], ...]}` with hand-constructed expectations for small
  cases and invariant-checked frozen characterization for large ones.
- `engine/merge3/` — 3-way merge cases (WP2 T2.4): `{"base": [...], "local":
  [...], "remote": [...], "expected_merge": [...], "expected_conflicts": [...]}`.
- `encodings/` — files for load/save round-trip tests (WP6 T6.3, WP9 T9.2):
  latin-1, utf-8 with astral-plane characters, utf-16, NUL-containing binary,
  mixed CRLF/LF, missing trailing newline.

The Python 2 original is never executed to produce expectations; see WP2 T2.2
for the trust order (hand-constructed > GNU diff cross-checks > invariants).
